description: Attempt to extract the single-level resurgence parameters (Gevrey order kappa, action A) of the D-ladder; honest outcome: at k=41 the growth FORM is unresolved (neither log|d|/(k log k) nor log|d|/k^2 plateaus), so (kappa,A) are length-blocked.

data.verdict: SINGLE-LEVEL RESURGENCE PARAMETERS ARE LENGTH-BLOCKED AT k=41 (scope-(a) negative). Now that two-level is ruled out, the single-instanton |d_k|~C(k!)^kappa/A^k extraction is well-posed IN PRINCIPLE, but at k=41 the growth FORM is not resolved: log|d|/(k log k) drifts (tail slope 4.156, no plateau => not ordinary Gevrey with a settled kappa) AND log|d|/k^2 drifts (tail slope 1.739, no plateau => not clean q-Gevrey either); the second difference Delta^2 log|d| has intercept -0.0008195 as 1/k->0 (~0 (consistent with kappa/k for the small drifting local kappa), mildly favoring ORDINARY Gevrey over q-Gevrey -- but with kappa still decreasing (0.064->0.026), far from a settled value). So (kappa, A) CANNOT be extracted here -- a Neville extrapolation of the non-converged local kappa_k sequence overshoots to nonsense (kappa~-11), the SYMPTOM of an unresolved form, not a result. This is the growth-form face of the merged 'no single Gevrey index' (#3839). DELIVERABLE: the single-level fibre Stokes datum's (kappa,A) parametrization needs far more exact rungs than k=41; the length-robust handle is the direct optimal-truncation Stokes floor already measured on the fibre (2026-07-18-dladder-fibre-branch-stokes-ambiguity). No fit; no c_k wired; no tier change.
